from starlette_prometheus import PrometheusMiddleware, metrics
from prometheus_client.parser import text_string_to_metric_families

async def snapshot(client, route):
    text = (await client.get("/metrics/")).text
    values = {}
    for family in text_string_to_metric_families(text):
        if family.type not in {"counter", "histogram"}:
            continue
        for sample in family.samples:
            if sample.labels.get("path_template") == route and sample.labels.get("method") == "GET":
                key = (sample.name, tuple(sorted(sample.labels.items())))
                values[key] = sample.value
    return values

async def observe(app):
    """Read-only async sandbox scaffold."""
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app, raise_app_exceptions=False), base_url="http://testserver") as client:
        for case in CASES:
            route = case["route_template"]
            before = await snapshot(client, route)
            response = await client.get(route)
            after = await snapshot(client, route)
            keys = sorted(set(before) | set(after))
            yield {"case": case, "actual_status": response.status_code,
                   "samples": [{"metric": key[0], "labels": dict(key[1]),
                                "before": before.get(key, 0), "after": after.get(key, 0),
                                "change": after.get(key, 0) - before.get(key, 0)} for key in keys]}

# Configure the maintained instrumentation below.
app.add_middleware(PrometheusMiddleware, filter_unhandled_paths=True)
app.add_route("/metrics/", metrics)
# After configuration, observe(app) computes before/after counter and histogram evidence.
# Compare returned responses to the escaping-exception case; isolate each matched route.

# Read-only verification scaffold.
async def metrics_probe(route):
    """Read-only async sandbox scaffold."""
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app, raise_app_exceptions=False), base_url="http://testserver") as client:
        before = await snapshot(client, route)
        response = await client.get(route)
        after = await snapshot(client, route)
        case = next(case for case in CASES if case["route_template"] == route)
        assert response.status_code == case["response_status"]
        def delta(name):
            return sum(v - before.get(k, 0) for k, v in after.items() if k[0] == name)
        # Read the real package's exact counter and histogram sample names.
        request_delta = delta("starlette_requests_total")
        response_delta = delta("starlette_responses_total")
        duration_count = delta("starlette_requests_processing_time_seconds_count")
        duration_sum = delta("starlette_requests_processing_time_seconds_sum")
        assert request_delta == 1
        assert response_delta == 1
        assert duration_count == int(case["returns_response"])
        if route == "/delayed":
            assert duration_sum >= CASES[2]["configured_delay_seconds"]
        for key in after:
            assert set(dict(key[1])) <= {"method", "path_template", "status_code", "exception_type", "le"}
        return {"route": route, "status": response.status_code, "request_delta": request_delta, "response_delta": response_delta, "duration_count": duration_count}

# Read-only async verification endpoint for the no-threads sandbox.
@app.get("/_probe")
async def sandbox_probe(route: str):
    """Read-only async sandbox scaffold."""
    return await metrics_probe(route)

from pydantic import BaseModel

class OrderUpdate(BaseModel):
    note: str | None = None
    quantity: int | None = None


def update_probe(value):
    # Scaffold inputs; edit only the TODO extraction assignments.
    quantity_only = OrderUpdate(quantity=2)
    explicit_null = OrderUpdate(note=None)
    concrete_note = OrderUpdate(note=value)
    quantity_update = quantity_only.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    null_update = explicit_null.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    note_update = concrete_note.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    quantity_fields = quantity_only.model_fields_set
    null_fields = explicit_null.model_fields_set
    note_fields = concrete_note.model_fields_set
    null_without_none = explicit_null.model_dump(exclude_unset=True, exclude_none=True)
    return {"quantity": quantity_update, "null": null_update, "note": note_update, "fields": [quantity_fields, null_fields, note_fields], "null_without_none": null_without_none}
